text:
maya: Heads up — flying into SYD next Tue, landing 11:20am. I have ~90min to get to Barangaroo for a 1pm meetup. Any quick lunch recs (halal-friendly and GF options preferred) that are walkable from Wynyard/Barangaroo? TIA :pray:

li: Saltwater Poke on Barangaroo Ave is super fast, bowls are GF (ask for no soy), decent for groups. 7–10 min from the wharf.

nora: If you want something more wrapped, Viet Roll on Kent St does shrimp/veggie rolls and they're out the door in 5–8 mins. Cheap and tasty.

tom: For halal, "Spice Alley" (little hawker-style spot near Dixon St) has a few stalls that do halal laksa / rice plates — not exactly Barangaroo but 12–15min walk from Wynyard. Fast service.

maya: Perfect — thank you! Is Saltwater Poke cashless? Also, is seating usually available for ~6 people around 12:45?

li: Cashless only (card/Apple Pay). Seating is limited but quick turnover. If you're six, order ahead? You can call but it's small — better to split into 2 orders.

samira: Another halal rec: 'Cairo Kitchen' on King St, takeaway only but 3–4 minute walk from Wynyard and they do great falafel bowls (GF avocado option).

nora: FYI the Barangaroo wharf has picnic benches — decent fallback if a place is full. Also a tiny park near the Customs House.

maya: Nice. Plan: land, grab a quick bag drop, aim to be at Saltwater Poke by 12:20 and meet at the benches if indoor seats are full. Thanks all :heart_eyes:

tom: +1 for benches plan. If you need train details, ping me — I live there so can give quick route.

ops-bot: Reminder — office check-in for visitors requires ID at reception after 12pm. (automated message)

maya: Good call @tom @nora — I'll DM if ETA changes. See you in Sydney :airplane:
